title: The indicative offer promises 7 days even when the supplier's quote behind it expires sooner
evidence: shared/orchestration/matchmaking.py:616 fixed text 'This indicative price is valid for 7 days'; the pair already knows the quote's remaining validity (matchmaking.py:345-346 expires_in)
impact: A buyer accepting on day 6 of an offer backed by a quote that lapsed on day 2 is owed a price PortLess may no longer be able to buy at — margin loss or a broken promise
fix: Validity = min(7, days the supplier quote has left − 1), stated as a date; below 2 days ask the supplier to reconfirm before sending
why_money: no offer outlives the cost it was priced on
